name: tweak-my-term
description: Build any terminal look on Windows, macOS or Linux from an image, a mood or a rice: visual anchor, palette, font, layout, prompt and tools, applied with a diff, an approval, a verify and a byte-for-byte undo.

startup_budget_ms.title: Shell startup budget (ms)
startup_budget_ms.description: tmt measure warns when a shell takes longer than this to start.

allow_installs.title: Allow package installs
allow_installs.description: Let tmt apply run the installs in an approved plan without asking again. Off: the agent must get your yes and pass --allow-installs.

package_manager.title: Preferred package manager
package_manager.description: winget, scoop, brew, apt, dnf, pacman, zypper or flatpak. Empty: pick the one detected.

guard_configs.title: Guard live terminal configs
guard_configs.description: Block direct edits to terminal and shell config files so every change goes through a backed-up, undoable tmt run.
